name: Next Level Education - Storytelling Video Agent (Claude)

flow.purpose: Writes the story: {narration, caption, video_theme} as strict JSON. See SKILL.md for the compliance rule this prompt encodes (no raw link/disclosure in the caption) and the no-quotation-marks rule (works around a Make formula limitation, see SKILL.md's 'formula gotcha' section).
Parses module 1's JSON string output into narration/caption/video_theme fields.

Builds a 1080x1920 vertical movie in one call: a looping background clip (picked by keyword-matching video_theme+narration against clips c01-c19, hosted on the user's own render service) plus an Azure-voiced ('en-NG-EzinneNeural', included free by JSON2Video - no separate Azure account needed) narration of the story text. Returns a project id.
Blocks until the movie from step 3 finishes rendering, returns movie.url. This is the step that reports 'not enough credits' if the JSON2Video account's quota is exhausted.

Posts the rendered video (by URL, not re-uploaded as raw bytes) to the Next Level Education Facebook Page. Caption has URLs and any disclosure/affiliate wording stripped - the disclosure lives in the comment instead (module 7).
Waits 90 seconds for Facebook to finish processing the video into a commentable post before the next step runs. Raise this if CreateComment keeps failing with 'object does not exist'.
Comments the disclosed affiliate link underneath the post.
